AcceptedResponse.title: AcceptedResponse

AuditItem.description: One audit record (state is stored as hashes only).
AuditItem.title: AuditItem

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. not_found or approval_required.
code.title: Code

IntegrationList.description: Every external service the platform uses.
IntegrationList.title: IntegrationList

Invitation.title: Invitation

InvitationCreate.description: Invite someone by email and/or phone.
InvitationCreate.title: InvitationCreate

InvitationCreated.title: InvitationCreated

MeMembership.description: A firm the user belongs to.
MeMembership.title: MeMembership

OtpVerifyRequest.title: OtpVerifyRequest

get.description:
Report that the process is serving requests; never touches the database.

Returns:
    {"status": "ok"}.

Report readiness: the database answers a ping and the platform indexes exist.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.

Returns:
    {"status": "ok"}.

Raises:
    ApiError: 503 database_unavailable when the database is unreachable or indexes are missing.

List the firm's audit records, newest first.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Firm owner.
    limit: Page size.
    cursor: Cursor from the previous page.

Returns:
    One page.

Raises:
    ApiError: 400 invalid_cursor.

post.description:
Revoke the caller's session family and clear the refresh cookie.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Signed-in user.

Returns:
    204 with the cookie cleared.

Bump the token epoch (every access token dies on its next use) and revoke every session.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Signed-in user.

Returns:
    204 with the cookie cleared.

Email a single-use sign-in link if the address belongs to an active user.

Args:
    body: The email address.
    request: Incoming request.

Returns:
    {"accepted": true} whether or not an email was sent.

Raises:
    ApiError: 503 when email sign-in is not configured, 429 over the limits.

Spend a magic-link token and sign the user in.

Args:
    body: The token from the link.
    request: Incoming request.
    response: Outgoing response.

Returns:
    Tokens.

Raises:
    ApiError: 503 when not configured, 429, 400 invalid_token for unknown, used or expired tokens, 401 when the
        account is disabled.

Text a one-time code to a phone.

Args:
    body: The phone.
    request: Incoming request.

Returns:
    {"sent": true}.

Raises:
    ApiError: 503 without Twilio, 429 over the limits, 502 when Twilio fails.

Check a code; sign in an existing user, or create the user and queue the firm for a new phone.

Args:
    body: Phone, code, and for a new phone firm_name and accept_terms.
    request: Incoming request.
    response: Outgoing response (refresh cookie for browsers).

Returns:
    Tokens; a new signup gets tid=null, role=owner, state=provisioning and a signup_token.

Raises:
    ApiError: 503 without Twilio or JWT keys, 422 signup_details_required, 429, 502, 400 invalid_code, 409.
post.summary: Sign in or sign up with a code

post.description:
Exchange a refresh token (body for native clients, mc_refresh cookie for browsers) for new tokens.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    response: Outgoing response.
    body: Optional body with refresh_token.
    mc_refresh: Browser refresh cookie.

Returns:
    New tokens; the old refresh token is spent.

Raises:
    ApiError: 401 invalid_refresh or refresh_reuse (the family is then revoked), 429, 503.

Exchange a carrier link token for a 60-minute portal token (aud=portal, role=carrier, sub=carrier id).

Args:
    body: Link token.
    request: Incoming request.

Returns:
    The portal token.

Raises:
    ApiError: 401 invalid_link for unknown, revoked or expired links; 429; 503 without JWT keys.

Point the current session at a firm the user belongs to and issue a firm access token.

Args:
    body: Optional firm id (checked against the user's memberships).
    request: Incoming request.
    response: Outgoing response.
    principal: Signed-in user.

Returns:
    A new access token for the firm; the refresh token is unchanged.

Raises:
    ApiError: 404 or 409 as in `_switch_target`.
post.summary: Switch this session to a firm

get.description:
Return the caller's firm.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Firm member.

Returns:
    The firm.

patch.description:
Change the firm's name or timezone (audited).

Args:
    body: Fields to change.
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Firm owner.

Returns:
    The updated firm.

get.description:
Report the caller's latest signup; poll until `ready`, then call /v1/auth/switch-firm.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Signed-in user.

Returns:
    The provisioning status.

Report which external services are configured (never their credentials).

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Firm member.

Returns:
    Status per service.

post.description:
Join the firm that issued an invitation; the signed-in user's email or phone must match it.

Args:
    body: Invitation token.
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Signed-in user.

Returns:
    The firm and role; switch to it with /v1/auth/switch-firm.

Raises:
    ApiError: 404 unknown, used or expired; 403 invitation_mismatch; 409 already_member; 429.

get.description:
Return the signed-in user, their firms and the current firm.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Signed-in user.

Returns:
    The user.

patch.description:
Change the caller's name or email (emails are unique across users).

Args:
    body: Fields to change.
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Signed-in user.

Returns:
    The updated user.

Raises:
    ApiError: 409 email_taken.

get.description:
List the firm's members, oldest first.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Firm member.
    limit: Page size.
    cursor: Cursor from the previous page.

Returns:
    One page.

Raises:
    ApiError: 400 invalid_cursor.

List the firm's pending, unexpired invitations, oldest first.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Firm owner.
    limit: Page size.
    cursor: Cursor from the previous page.

Returns:
    One page.

Raises:
    ApiError: 400 invalid_cursor.

post.description:
Create an invitation and return its one-time token and accept URL (sending it is up to the owner).

Args:
    body: Who to invite and with which role.
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Firm owner.
    guard: Idempotency guard (Idempotency-Key header optional).

Returns:
    The invitation with its token.

delete.description:
Revoke a pending invitation of the caller's firm.

Args:
    invitation_id: Invitation id.
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Firm owner.

Returns:
    204.

Raises:
    ApiError: 404 when it is not a pending invitation of this firm.

Remove a member (audited; access ends on their next request); the last owner cannot be removed.

Args:
    user_id: Member's user id.
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Firm owner.

Returns:
    204.

Raises:
    ApiError: 404 not a member of this firm, 409 last_owner.

patch.description:
Change a member's role (audited); the last owner cannot be demoted.

Args:
    user_id: Member's user id.
    body: New role.
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Firm owner.

Returns:
    The updated member.

Raises:
    ApiError: 404 not a member of this firm, 409 last_owner.

get.description:
Return the carrier and firm a portal token belongs to.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Portal principal.

Returns:
    Carrier id and name and the firm name.

Raises:
    ApiError: 404 when the carrier no longer exists in the firm.

List the caller's live sessions (one per device sign-in), newest first.

Args:
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Signed-in user.

Returns:
    All live sessions; next_cursor is always null (the list is bounded by refresh expiry).

delete.description:
Revoke a session (its whole family) that belongs to the caller.

Args:
    session_id: Session id.
    request: Incoming request.
    principal: Signed-in user.

Returns:
    204.

Raises:
    ApiError: 404 when the session is not the caller's.

get.description:
Report a signup's status by its unguessable token (public, rate limited per IP).

Args:
    token: Signup status token.
    request: Incoming request.

Returns:
    Status, the tenant id once ready, and a message when failed.

Raises:
    ApiError: 404 for an unknown token, 429 over the limit.
